# <!--name-->edot-release/draft-release-notes<!--/name-->

[![usages](https://img.shields.io/badge/usages-white?logo=githubactions&logoColor=blue)](https://github.com/search?q=elastic%2Foblt-actions%2Fedot-release%2Fdraft-release-notes+%28path%3A.github%2Fworkflows+OR+path%3A**%2Faction.yml+OR+path%3A**%2Faction.yaml%29&type=code)
[![test-edot-release-draft-release-notes](https://github.com/elastic/oblt-actions/actions/workflows/test-edot-release-draft-release-notes.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/elastic/oblt-actions/actions/workflows/test-edot-release-draft-release-notes.yml)

<!--description-->
Draft EDOT release-note JSON from the pull requests in a release range.
<!--/description-->

## Inputs

<!--inputs-->
| Name           | Description                                                          | Required | Default                    |
|----------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|----------------------------|
| `ref`          | Commit or ref at the end of the range.                               | `false`  | `${{ github.sha }}`        |
| `ref-name`     | Branch name used to derive the previous tag for a patch release.     | `false`  | `${{ github.ref_name }}`   |
| `previous-tag` | Release tag at the start of the range. Defaults from ref-name.       | `false`  | ` `                        |
| `tag-prefix`   | Prefix on release tags, such as v. Leave empty for plain X.Y.Z tags. | `false`  | ` `                        |
| `repository`   | GitHub repository whose pull requests are resolved.                  | `false`  | `${{ github.repository }}` |
| `github-token` | GitHub token used by the commits API.                                | `false`  | `${{ github.token }}`      |
<!--/inputs-->

## Outputs

<!--outputs-->
| Name    | Description                                       |
|---------|---------------------------------------------------|
| `notes` | Draft release-note JSON grouped by release label. |
<!--/outputs-->

## Usage

The repository must be checked out with full history and tags.

<!--usage action="elastic/oblt-actions/edot-release/draft-release-notes" version="env:VERSION"-->
```yaml
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v7
    with:
      fetch-depth: 0
  - uses: elastic/oblt-actions/edot-release/draft-release-notes@v1
    with:
      tag-prefix: v
```
<!--/usage-->
